fields.description: Program Description 1. Major Training Objectives Editor Note: Students are mainly engage in project design, research and development, network operation, equipment manufacturing, and technical management in the field of info-communications after graduation. This program aims to cultivate high-quality personnel with practical and innovative abilities who shall have a good command of basic theory and professional knowledge of telecommunications, and technologies related to telecommunications systems and networks. The graduates shall be able to engage in project design, research and development, network operation, equipment manufacturing, and technical management in the field of info-communications. 2. Specialty Core Courses Editor Note: The core courses listed are only samples, not all the courses. Series courses of Circuits, Computer Networks, Signal & Linear Systems, Digital Signal Processing, Stochastic Signal Analysis, Electromagnetic Fields and Waves, Principles of Communications, and Information Theory and Coding. 3. Program Composition and Distribution of Course Hours and Credits Editor Note: The total credits for graduation are 155 points. For a Bachelor's degree in engineering, a student must achieve 18 credits in general education courses, 29.5 credits in discipline fundamental courses, 50 credits in specialty required courses, 26.5 credits in specialty elective courses, and 31 credits for the practical, amounting to a total of 155 credits. A minimum of 12 credits is required of the students for one semester except for the short summer semester. 4. Guiding Arrangements Editor Note: The courses type, course name and credits are describe detailly in the follow table, students can know more about the program well. General Education Course Table Discipline Fundamental Course Table Specialty Core Course Table Specialty Elective Course Table Internship and Practical Training Table（Non-independent course experiments are not included） 5. Main Practical Teaching and Internship Editor Note: Students of this program are required to complete practical teaching and internship before graduation. Electronic Processing Practice; Internship; Graduation Practice; Graduation Project; Specialty Course Experiments, Course Design, etc. 6. School Introduction Editor Note: SDUST has the excellent academic performance, deep foundation of culture and a modern open environment. Shandong University of Science and Technology (SDUST), a key university of Shandong Province with distinct features, founded in 1951, is a multi-disciplinary university, offering comprehensive education in engineering, sciences, management, humanities, law, economics and education while giving prominence to engineering and the integration of science and engineering. Learn More>> About College of Chemical and Environmental Engineering There are 90 staff in the College of Chemical and Environmental Engineering, including 17 professors, 6 doctoral supervisors, 41 associate professors, 58 teachers holding doctoral diploma. It sets up the Department of Chemical Engineering, Department of Applied Chemistry, Department of Environmental Science & Engineering, Department of Biological Engineering, Department of Energy and Chemical Engineering and Basic Research Center etc. 7. Campus Life Editor Note: By experiencing Chinese life and culture, international students enjoy themselves a lot. Learn Tai-chi Learn in Practice Make "jiaozi"

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 3. English proficiency test certificate For applicants whose first language is not English, a minimum score of IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 is required. * 4. Senior high school Certificate/diploma or A Level Certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. Senior high school academic transcript or A level transcripts Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 6. Resume You MUST fill the form provided by school. You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Bank Statement * 8. Physical examination record for foreigner * 9. Introduce yourself video About 3-5 minutes. It should include the following information at least: -- A brief introduction,which should include your personal information, your family background, your guardian, your hobby, your awards chieved if have, and some other information you want us to know; -- What is your reason to study in China and apply to our university; -- How do you come to know our university; -- The future study plan, if you are a master or PHD applicants, you should say more about this part; -- Do you have any experience living or studying in China? If have, what impressed you most? -- Have you visited China before? Have you learned Chinese before? If you learned, which level you have reached? * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
